method: Tiny Python-only synthetic child/resource/signal mocks and read-only validation of eleven existing resource JSON records. No real Popen, browser, app tests, server or process signal was issued by the tested monitor. Includes cleanup timeout/permission/spawn/final-sample errors, deferred spawn signal, normal success/refusal/stop, and rejection counterexamples. This is helper verification, not native product verification or a measured CPU/RSS bound.
